data_note: Names, descriptions and grades are the official PlayStation list as published on Exophase and PSNProfiles (the two agree on every name, description and grade). Gamerscore values are reported from GTABase via GTA Zone and sum to exactly 1,000G. Difficulty labels are estimates, not official data. Five trophies carry unconfirmed triggers: nobody has published how they unlock yet, and their guides say so instead of guessing.

trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and the platinum unlocks on its own. There is no online trophy and no DLC trophy standing between you and it, so the whole set is finishable in one playthrough plus free-roam cleanup. Follow the three-step roadmap in this guide: story first, then the 100% checklist, then Strangers & Freaks and the remaining one-offs.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Reach 100% Completion by finishing the 35 items in the checklist section of this guide. The checklist only becomes visible after the story (Progress > Stats > 100% Completion), but progress made during the story counts, and nothing on it is missable. Budget roughly 100 hours after the credits: most categories only need a share of their total — for example 200 of 277 vehicles, 100 of 255 animals and 70 of 80 challenges.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Finish the final story mission (Chapter 5). It unlocks automatically when the credits roll; no choice or extra objective is attached to it.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Complete “Gone Fishing”, the first main mission (Chapter 1). Automatic story progress — no special action is needed.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 1. The trophy pops after the first mission of Chapter 2, “What's in the Bag?”.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 2. It pops after the first mission of Chapter 3, “Welcome to Vice City”. The name is printed censored exactly as PlayStation publishes it.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 3. It pops after the first two missions of Chapter 4, “Ocean Beach” and “Another Life”.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4. It pops after the Chapter 4 finale, “Starting From Zero”.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Complete the mission “Breakfast Run” (Chapter 2). Automatic.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Complete “The Cartel Heist” (Chapter 3). Automatic.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Complete “Child's Play” (Chapter 4). Automatic.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Complete “Headliners” (Chapter 4). Automatic.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Complete “VCIA Takedown” (Chapter 4). Automatic.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Complete “Operation Savage Glory” (Chapter 5). Automatic.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's final mission, “Randy's Wish List”: deliver the 16 sports cars he asks for. You unlock the Key Cloner during the Chapter 3 mission “Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS” (the Zorrusso counts automatically); track the list at Map > Robberies > Randy's Wish List. The cars are: Vitello, Infernus, Windsor Drop, Toros, Tempesta, Paragon, Jagular, Jubilee, Itali RSX, Growler, Gauntlet Hellfire, Furia, Dubsta, Banshee and Baller ST-D. It stays available after the story.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's final quest (a Lucia-only questline in Belville, from Chapter 3): Climbing the Cellerichain (Parts 1-3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label and Puff Puff Pass. It stays available after the story.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's final mission: clear all 7 shipwrecks while treasure diving around Key Lento (look for the “KR” icon). Kenton disappears for a while after Chapter 1 and returns in Chapters 2-3 — call Brian as Jason to speed his return. Track it at Progress > Characters > Kenton Rees.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's final mission at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County (opens after Chapter 2, “Coffee Break”): Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler and Hometown Heroes.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's final mission (Jason-only, opens after Chapter 3, “Here, Kitty Kitty”): destroy the Synthetic Labs in Vice City (“Take Out Kitty Litter”), then take the “Spin On This” quest.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret Vogel (Jason-only; he texts after Chapter 2, “Coffee Break”, in Lummox County; first quest “Veteran Hunted”). Bret rewards you with the unique rifle “Killtelligence SM-69”. Note: which exact animal triggers the trophy is still being confirmed by the community — this guide will be updated when it is pinned down.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Confirmed to count: Kirk (Skunk Ape: Skunk Apeology 101, Tree Effigies, Advanced Skunk Apeonomics), Kyle (McKittrick Farm, Chemicals, Buddy?), Yago (Street Race, Bumper to Bumper, Race Against Yago, Brother to Brother) and Pilot Pete (The Last Mile x2 plus deliveries). Not counted: Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy, Eddie and others. Four further strands have not yet been found or confirmed — this guide will be updated as the community finds them. Track progress with the in-game trophy tracker.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts of any kind (300 count toward 100% Completion). Four types feed the total: 130 Stunt Jumps, 202 Under the Bridges (the fastest to grind), 40 Knife Flights and 25 Base Jumps. Track it at Progress > Activities > Stunts and find spots at Map > Exploration > Stunt Spots.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges across the 12 ranges. This is the most skill-demanding trophy in the set — practice the range drills and use the range's own scoring feedback to learn each one's timing.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once: Fishing, Hunting, Golf, Shooting Ranges, Pool, Basketball, Video Game, winning a Car Race / Race Challenge / Top Fun Drone Race, and performing a Stunt. Track it at Touchpad > Progress > Activities; most of it happens naturally while chasing the other trophies.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races (of 40 unique races). Winning the same race twice does not count — you need 20 distinct wins.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at each of the 14 locations (42 races in total; all 42 count toward 100% Completion).
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Cal texts you after the Chapter 1 mission (Feng Shui / Meet Cal) and marks the spot with a purple icon — follow his fishing questline.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game (4 games: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind on the TV at home; Bang For Your Buck on an arcade machine). “Complete” means finishing all of its levels once — you do not need every challenge. Available from Chapter 1.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape (all 8 count toward 100% Completion). Unlocks through the optional Chapter 4 mission “That's Where The Money Is… (Wait at the Cafe)”. Method: follow a security van to its bank, enter while the vault is open, and bring your partner (hold the call button to hand over the bag). Each vault triggers a 4-star wanted level instantly — escape on a fast bike, then switch vehicles. Pay Yasmani $10,000 for van tips (after 2 Payday Loan jobs). A single large vault can pay up to $205,000.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level while your partner is with you. Available after Chapter 2, “Coffee Break” (call your partner with hold + triangle). Easiest spot: the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County, where police and helicopters struggle to follow. It usually pops naturally while robbing vaults, once you leave the red “heat” zone.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level — the flashing red/blue wanted level must stay active throughout. Good spot: the 3 jewelry stores north of Vice City (after Chapter 3, Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs). Loot the shelves and the back safe (sticky bomb). The trophy pops about 30 seconds after the third shop; if it does not, rob a fourth.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one Illegal Operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs (39 operations in total; all 39 count toward 100% Completion). Yellow icons appear on the map as you approach; 19 are marked automatically through the story. Track it at Progress > Gangs.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies during a single use of Combat Focus (L3+R3 while aiming). It does not count against soldiers, police or civilians — fight criminals at Gang Operations. Buff Focus first (eat and drink; Adrenaline stretches it), use an assault rifle such as the Duke 556, and note that Focus Level 4 makes it much easier (raise it through Shooting Ranges, Golf, Pool, fishing and headshots).
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. First finish Chapter 3, “Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs”, which unlocks the Snap Gun — use it to pick the back door without tripping the alarm. Enter through the back, find the safe code note, and empty the safe. Good location: Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds, Vice City.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. It unlocks automatically through the optional Chapter 4 mission “That's Where The Money Is…” (a bank vault counts as an armored truck). Earlier option: block an armored truck near a bank, stick a sticky bomb to its rear door, detonate it, then escape the “heat” radius.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets (of 18 sets; 480 cards in total; 15 sets count toward 100% Completion).
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations (a mix of 31 Landmarks, 35 Curiosities, 23 Sculptures and No Flusher tags). Scan by holding up + R1; a popup appears when a scannable spot is near (on foot).
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — clear the fog from the entire map. Fastest by plane.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles with the WAiNK scan (200 of 277 base models count toward 100% Completion; 557 vehicles in total at launch). Scanning is enough — you do not need to drive them. Track it at Touchpad > Progress > Vehicles.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts (running total). Unlock the Dye Pack Jammer in Chapter 3, “Credit Check”. Rob banks and Payday Loans, then fence the bills — Yasmani pays the most. One large vault can pay $205,000 in a single run.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops (running total). Fastest on weapons, car mods and tattoos (14 mod shops, 19 Pay 'n' Sprays, 24 Ammu-Nations, 67 clothing stores, 17 footwear stores, 18 salons, 11 tattoo studios, 15 electronics stores).
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Buy all 8 garage properties for sale (about $160,000 in total; the 4 story garages do not count). Available after Chapter 2, “Daily Driver”, through the Vice City Real Estate app on your phone.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles in the Scooter Bros app (Moses, after Chapter 2, “Moses (Take A Vehicle to Moses)”). You need an empty garage slot (see Little Boxes). Bring a stolen vehicle to Moses in Port Gellhorn, choose Respray, then Register. Early on only vehicles without a tracker can be registered; from Chapter 3, fit a Standard Tracker at a Pay 'n' Spray. Use cheap cars and bikes to keep the cost down.
trophies.name: On the Spot

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot in Leonida: 18 spots across 10 locations, with Jason AND Lucia (each spot counts +2 when done together). Track it at Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations. THE MISSABLE ONE: the first meditation spot is at Jason's home in Chapter 1 — after the mission “Down to Earth”, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning (“You know what I'm gonna do? Meditate”), follow her to the balcony and choose “Accept”. It disappears permanently after Chapter 1, and it is not yet confirmed whether the trophy requires it — do it to be safe. The final meditation needs Jason and Lucia together (after Chapter 2, “Coffee Break”). For 100% Completion only 15 of 18 spots are needed, so this spot cannot block A Long Road.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the 80 Challenges (70 count toward 100% Completion). There are 8 categories x 10 challenges; track them at Progress > Challenges (a Completed mark shows at the bottom right). Most complete passively; save the easiest ones for last.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA: steal a large passenger plane connected to a boarding bridge (terminals E3/E4 are easiest — slip in through the airfield fence or walk in through the terminal), climb aboard, enter the cockpit, reverse onto the runway, take off and fly about 1 km from the airport. The trophy pops with a delay.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: “Kinda hot in these Rhinos.” Steal a tank at Mile Zero Air Station (the island in the south-west of the map, Mariana County; the tank sits south of the base) and shoot enemies from inside until it pops.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley: steal the 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn (a Gang Operation; optional Chapter 2 mission “Hit Kingpin Bowling”): the luxury watch (south-east office), the unique shotgun “Gutterball Moreland 850” (north-east table) and the safe (north-east corridor — blow it with a Sticky Bomb). It pops after you escape the police. The three items do not need to be taken at once; the robbery icon respawns (slowly).
trophies.name: Let's Go Bowling

trophies.guide: Reach MAXIMUM Strength for Jason AND Lucia at the same time. Gyms open after Chapter 2, “Coffee Break”; always train together (your partner trains alongside you automatically, so progress counts double). Check it at Touchpad > Jason & Lucia > Strength (heart icon).
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Make 500 choices that change your Criminal Profile (track it in the trophy list; turn on notifications at Settings > UI > HUD Notifications > Criminal Profile = On). It happens passively while chasing the other trophies. Warning: do NOT chase the Irredeemable profile — it is permanent and makes police far more aggressive.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Trigger not yet known to anyone — PowerPyx lists it as currently unknown, and this guide will be updated the moment the community cracks it.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Trigger not yet known. Best guess from the description: drive out through a showroom window — a guess, not a confirmed step.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. Trigger not yet known. Best guess: linked to the Payday Loans shop from the Prologue — a guess, not a confirmed step.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? Trigger not yet known. Best guess: a UFO questline — a guess, not a confirmed step.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. Trigger not yet known. Best guess: kick an enemy while riding a motorbike — a guess, not a confirmed step.
trophies.name: Ten Pin
